name: brickproof-adb
description: Lets Claude look after your own Android devices and TV boxes over ADB without bricking them.
long_description: Claude gets the screen, the input and the package manager of your Android devices, over USB or the network, with guard rails: every package change is a dry run first, packages the device cannot live without are refused, a package serving something on your network right now is not touched, and everything applied goes into a snapshot that one call rolls back. Needs adb (Android SDK Platform-Tools) on this computer; brickproof-adb finds it, or downloads it with `brickproof-adb get-adb`.

env.BRICKPROOF_SETTINGS_UI: the extension settings in Claude Desktop

file_roots.title: Folders for files
file_roots.description: Folders on this computer the assistant may copy files from and to, and install APKs from. Empty: the Downloads folder of this computer, which the server finds by itself.

allow_shell.title: Allow any shell command
allow_shell.description: Lets the assistant run any command on the device, past every guard rail. Off unless you need it.

allow_uninstall.title: Allow uninstalling
allow_uninstall.description: Lets the assistant uninstall apps (with a backup) instead of only disabling them.

devices.title: TV addresses
devices.description: Optional: network addresses to connect at start, separated by commas (192.0.2.50 or 192.0.2.50:5555). You can leave it empty: the assistant finds devices and remembers them.

adb_path.title: adb program
adb_path.description: Optional: the adb program to use. Empty: brickproof-adb finds one.

tools.name: adb_devices
tools.description: List devices; discover=true finds devices on the network

tools.name: adb_pair
tools.description: Pair an Android 11+ device over Wireless debugging

tools.name: adb_shell
tools.description: Run a shell command (off unless allowed)

tools.name: adb_ui_dump
tools.description: List on-screen elements with tap points

tools.name: adb_find_and_tap
tools.description: Find an element by its label and activate it

tools.name: adb_install
tools.description: Install an app (dry run by default), or list the installable files

tools.name: adb_push
tools.description: Copy a file to the device

tools.name: adb_pull
tools.description: Copy a file from the device

tools.name: adb_app
tools.description: Manage packages with dry runs, guards and rollback
